scope: Eight exact identities recalled from a bounded Google COLM 2026 source; not new first publications and not an institution-exhaustive scan.

integration_corrections.initial_failure: The initial satisfies predicate accepted a goal-tower prefix, so State(((A,x),)) with singleton goal(A) was treated as solved by BFS at cost0 while Eq1 returned2. It also allowed a held obstacle to count as finished. Initial multi-target permutation tests did not cover this; they must not be described as validation of singleton HighTowers goals.
integration_corrections.fix: Require the exact complete clear target tower and an empty hand. Add independent BFS controls with one/two covering blocks, a held obstacle needing putdown, an empty plan and an unfinished one-action plan.
integration_corrections.evidence_disposition: Initial frozen-run proof is superseded for delivery; integration owner must freeze and execute all final sources again. This correction concerns only the CPU verifier, not the two CUDA kernels or original paper results.
